criteria.name: Thumb-stop cover
criteria.notes: Despike removed the Goose Bay needles and the east extension removed the cut wall; 9-word number-led headline lands at thumb size. Held at 7.5: the terrain is still soft olive felt with an unfocused lower 35% and reads as generic relief without its labels.

criteria.name: Story arc & swipe momentum
criteria.notes: 01-02, 05-06 and 08-09 pull and 06's forward line plants 07. Weak: 02-03 and 03-04 junctions, 05 could move, 08's lead 'The cost has a source.' is vague, 06's three-line label runs two facts together.

criteria.name: Artwork craft & genuine detail
criteria.notes: 07 now holds the whole route with both rings on a depth-falling mesh; 09 sits on its true bearing; 01 free of spikes and cut wall; 03, 05, 06, 08 hold. Under 8: 04 unchanged (qa still logs the parallel-seeded lay), 02 still reads as fur at full size with a dead left column, 01's foreground soft.

criteria.name: Story-art fusion
criteria.notes: True OSM alignment on every frame, hollow ends, to-scale money bar and tally, true-area acreage, day rail at true spacing. 05 encodes place more than the 34-year wait; 06's unpinned ring sits on an arbitrary spot.

criteria.name: Alaska authenticity & local relevance
criteria.notes: 09's geography slip fixed. Named places, organisations, history and dates on real DEM and OSM data. Cover terrain still doesn't read as Mat-Su without labels.

criteria.name: Insight density & factual weight
criteria.notes: Every content slide adds a verified specific in 25-40 words; 08 repeats three earlier figures; 05 thin by design.

criteria.name: Variety vs ledger
criteria.notes: Reuses the one-object, a-different-instrument-per-frame system of No.121 to No.123 and is close to No.94's concept; several reused subsystems.

criteria.name: Legibility & platform fitness
criteria.notes: Floors met, counters and locator on every frame, vector PDF 9.78 MB with title. Squeakers: 16 px credit, 04 leader touching 'ALMOST', 07 credit close under 'RECONSIDERATION DUE', 06 run-together label.

criteria.name: Copy: voice & hook
criteria.notes: 93-character question hook, 880 chars, clear position and a real price question; opens on a question, summary line is furniture.

criteria.name: Deliverable completeness
criteria.notes: Vector PDF, title, thumbs, contact sheet, 3 hashtags, dated source-first comment, aftercare and editor notes present; Gmail draft and main URLs not verifiable at Phase 10.
